orders.not-found: The requested order was not found
orders.soft-deleted: Order was soft deleted (hidden from the customer).

cancel.not-cancellable: This order can no longer be cancelled.

override.not-allowed: This override cannot move the order to that status from where it is now.

orders.invoiced: This order has an issued invoice and can no longer be permanently deleted.

email-confirm.subject: Order received — awaiting payment
email-confirm.body: We've received your order. It's awaiting payment — nothing has been charged yet.

email-paid.subject: Payment received
email-paid.body: We've received your payment — your order is now being prepared.

email-transfer.subject: Complete your order by bank transfer
email-transfer.body: Your order is reserved. Send the transfer below to complete it — include the reference so we can match your payment.

email-withdrawal.heading: Right of withdrawal
email-withdrawal.right: You have the right to withdraw from this contract within {{days}} days without giving any reason.
email-withdrawal.period-goods: The withdrawal period will expire after {{days}} days from the day on which you acquire, or a third party other than the carrier and indicated by you acquires, physical possession of the goods.
email-withdrawal.period-digital: The withdrawal period will expire after {{days}} days from the day of the conclusion of the contract.
email-withdrawal.how: To exercise the right of withdrawal, you must inform us ({{- trader}}) of your decision to withdraw from this contract by an unequivocal statement (e.g. a letter sent by post, fax or e-mail). You may use the model withdrawal form below, but it is not obligatory.
email-withdrawal.online: You can also exercise your right of withdrawal online at {{- url}}. If you use this online feature, we will send you an acknowledgement of receipt of the withdrawal on a durable medium (e.g. by email), including its content and the date and time of its submission, without undue delay.
email-withdrawal.deadline: To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient for you to send your communication concerning your exercise of the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period has expired.
email-withdrawal.effects: If you withdraw from this contract, we shall reimburse to you all payments received from you, including the costs of delivery (with the exception of the supplementary costs resulting from your choice of a type of delivery other than the least expensive type of standard delivery offered by us), without undue delay and in any event not later than {{refundDays}} days from the day on which we are informed about your decision to withdraw from this contract. We will carry out such reimbursement using the same means of payment as you used for the initial transaction, unless you have expressly agreed otherwise; in any event, you will not incur any fees as a result of such reimbursement.
email-withdrawal.withhold: We may withhold reimbursement until we have received the goods back or you have supplied evidence of having sent back the goods, whichever is the earliest.
email-withdrawal.send-back: You shall send back the goods or hand them over to {{- recipient}}, without undue delay and in any event not later than {{returnDays}} days from the day on which you communicate your withdrawal from this contract to us. The deadline is met if you send back the goods before the period of {{returnDays}} days has expired.
email-withdrawal.postage-shop: We will bear the cost of returning the goods.
email-withdrawal.postage-consumer: You will have to bear the direct cost of returning the goods.
email-withdrawal.diminished: You are only liable for any diminished value of the goods resulting from the handling other than what is necessary to establish the nature, characteristics and functioning of the goods.
email-withdrawal.none: There is no right of withdrawal for this order: everything in it is excluded from it (Art. 16 of Directive 2011/83/EU).
email-withdrawal.trader: {{- name}}, {{- address}}, telephone {{- phone}}, e-mail {{- email}}
email-withdrawal.form-intro: (complete and return this form only if you wish to withdraw from the contract)
email-withdrawal.form-notice: I/We (*) hereby give notice that I/We (*) withdraw from my/our (*) contract of sale of the following goods (*)/for the provision of the following service (*),
email-withdrawal.form-signature: Signature of consumer(s) (only if this form is notified on paper),

email-transfer-expired.subject: Your order was cancelled — no transfer received
email-transfer-expired.body: We didn't receive your bank transfer in time, so this order has been cancelled and its items released.

email-card-expired.subject: Your order was cancelled — payment not completed
email-card-expired.body: We didn't receive your payment in time, so this order has been cancelled and its items released.

email-cancelled.subject: Your order was cancelled
email-cancelled.refund-paid: {{amount}} is being returned to the payment method you used. How long it takes to show up depends on your bank or card issuer.
email-cancelled.refund-none: No refund was issued with this cancellation. If you think that is a mistake, please contact us.
email-cancelled.refund-unpaid: You had not paid for this order, so nothing was charged.

email-refunded.subject: Your refund has been issued
email-refunded.body: We have refunded {{amount}} for your order {{order}}.
email-refunded.detail-full: That is everything you paid for this order.
email-refunded.detail-partial: That is part of what you paid; the rest of the payment stays with the order. How long it takes to show up depends on your bank or card issuer.

orders.insufficient-stock: Some items on this order are no longer available in the quantity requested — see `details.lines`.
